content: Zi Khul Thu
Jesus tua mun pan ding in, Jordan ngun ngal khat Judah ngam kimkot teng ah pai hi: mipi te a kungah hong ki kaikhawm kik leleau a; a hil ngei bang in thuhil kik hi.
Pharisee te a kungah hongpai a, pasal khat in a zi khul tu ngeina a om ziam? ci ze-et in dong uh hi.
Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: Moses in note bang thu hong pia ziam?

content: ci in zo hi.
Taciang amate in, Moses in khul na lai at in, zi khul tu oai hi, ci uh hi.
Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: Moses in na thinpui lei uh hang in hi ngeina a at a hihi.
Ahihang Pathian in a kipatcil bitphuana hun lai in pa le numei vawt hi.
Tua ahikom pasal in a pa le a nu nusia tu a, a zi beal tu hi;
Taciang amate ni sia taksa pumkhat hi tu hi: tua ahikom amate sia ni hi nawn ngawl tu a taksa pumkhat a hi uh hi.
Tua ahikom Pathian in a ngawm sa te mihing in khen heak tahen,

content: ci in zo hi.
Innsung ah a nungzui te in tua thu ma dong kik uh hi.
Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: A kuamapo in a zi khul in, ngualdang a tenpui le palngul mawna vawt a hihi.
Zi in a pasal nusia in, pasal dang a nei kik le, palngul mawna vawt a hihi,

content: ci hi.
Jesus in Patang te Thupha Pia
Amate in a tate uh a thamsak tu dei in Jesus kungah paipui uh a: a nungzui te in amate tei hi.
Ahihang Jesus in a mu ciang in, a thin-uk a, amate tung ah,

content.text: Patangno te ka kung hong paisak tavun, khak heak vun: banghangziam cile Pathian kumpingam sia hibang patang te atu a hihi.
A tatak in kong ci ciang, a kuamapo hibang patangno bang in Pathian kumpingam a sang ngawl peuma, Pathian kumpingam sungah tum ngawl tu hi,

content: ci hi.
Taciang Jesus in patang te toai a, amate tungah a khut nga in, thupha pia hi.
Mihau Tangvalpa
Jesus lamkal ah a pai laitak in, mi khat hong tai a, khupdin in, Sya pha awng, tawntung nuntakna ka nga thei natu in bang vawt tu khi ziam? ci in dong hi.
Taciang Jesus in ama kungah,

content.text: Banghang in, pha, hong ci ni ziam? Pathian khatbek simngawl kuama a pha om ngawl hi.
Thupiak te he ni hi, palngul mawna vawt heak in, tual that heak in, nguta heak in, a man ngawl tettipang heak in, ngual neisa sut heak in, na nu le na pa zakta in,

content: ci hi.
Taciang tua pa in Jesus kungah, Syapa awng, hite theampo ka no lai pan in zuisiat zo khi hi, ci in zo hi.
Tasiaciang Jesus in ama itna taw en a,

content.text: Khat bek kisam lai ni hi: pai tan a, na neisa theampo zuak siat in, taciang mizawng te pia in, tua hile vantung ah neisa na nei tu hi: taciang hongpai tan a, thinglamte pua in hong zui tan,

content: ci hi.
Tua thu hang in ama khuangai mama a, thinna in paisan hi: banghangziam cile a neisa tam mama hi.
Jesus in a kimkot teng en a, a nungzui te kungah,

content.text: Mihau te Pathian kumpingam sung a tum tu uh bangza in haksa ziam!

content: ci hi.
Taciang a nungzui te in Jesus i son thu hang in lungmang mamatek uh hi. Ahihang Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: Ka tate awng, hauna a muang te atu in Pathian kumpingam sungah tum tu sia bangza in haksa ziam!
Mihau pa Pathian kumpingam sungah a tum tu sang in, phin bilvang sungah kala-uk tum tu ol zaw hi,

content: ci in zo kik hi.
Amate in lamdangsa mamatek uh a, tabang hithong le, a kua peuma ngupna nga thei tu ziam? ci in amate kikum uh hi.
Taciang Jesus in amate en a,

content.text: Hi thu sia mihing te atu in suak thei ngawl hi, ahihang Pathian atu in hi ngawl hi: banghangziam cile Pathian atu in na theampo suak thei hi,

content: ci hi.
Tuazawkciang in Peter in, Jesus kungah, en in, kote ka hi uh le na theampo nusia in kong zui uh hi, ci hi.
Jesus in,

content.text: A tatak in kong son hi, a kuamapo keima le lungdamna thu hang in a inn le lo a hi zong, a u le a nau a hi zong, a nu le a pa a hi zong, a zi le a ta te a hi zong, a nusia a hile,
Tu hun in inn le lo hi kale, nu te hi kale, u le nau hi kale, tate hi kale, vawtsiatna tatuam taw a se za in sang tu a; hongpai lai tu hun ah tawntung nuntakna sang tu hi.
Ahihang a masabel te nungkhakbel tu a; a nungkhakbel te masabel hi tu hi,

content: ci hi.
Jesus in a Thi tu Thumvei na Son

Amate Jerusalem pai na lamkal ah hi uh a; Jesus amate mai ah pai hi: taciang amate in lamdangsa in, a nung pan zui kawm in lau tek mama uh hi. A nungzui sawmleni te sam a, a tungah thupiang tu te son kipan hi,

content.text: En vun, Jerusalem sangah i pai hi; mihing Tapa sia thiampi lian te le thukhamhil te kungah ap tu hi; amate in thi tu in thukhen tu uh a, Gentile te kungah ap tu uh hi:
Amate in selno tu a, vel in cilphi tu uh hi, taciang that tu uh a: nithum ni ciang in thokik tu hi,

content: ci hi.
Zebedee Zi in a Tate atu Jesus Kung ah Ngetsak
Zebedee tapa James le John te Jesus kungah hongpai uh a, Syapa awng, kong nget tu uh sia nong vawtsak tu ka uk uh hi, ci uh hi.
Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: No atu in bang hong vawtsak tu khi ziam?

content: ci hi.
Amate in, na minthanna sungah khat na ziatsang ah, a dang khat na veisang ah hong tosak tan, ci uh hi.
Hi kamale, Jesus in,

content.text: Bang ngen nu ziam ci zong he ngawl nu hi: ka dawn tu hai dawn zo tu nu ziam, ka san tu baptisma sang zo tu nu ziam?

content: ci hi.
Amate in, zo tu khu hi, ci uh hi. Jesus in,

content.text: Ka dawn tu hai dawn takpi tu nu hi, ka san tu baptisma zong sang takpi tu nu hi:
Ahihang ka ziatsang le ka veisang a to tute sia kei i piak tu hi ngawl a; ka Pa in a ngealkholsa te pia tu hi,

content: ci hi.
Tua thu a dang sawm te in a zak uh ciang in, James le John tungah a lung uh kim ngawl hi.
Ahihang Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: Na heak uh bang ma in Gentile kumpi te in a mihing te sia zawthawk thu taw uk uh a, ulian te in mipi te tungah thuneina zang tawntung uh hi.
Ahihang no sungah hibang hi ngawl tu hi: note sungah khatpo a lian nuam le, note i naseam hi tahen:
Note sung pan khatpo in a lu bel a hi nuam le, note i sila hi tahen.
Mihing Tapa sia ngual a sawl tu in hongpai ngawl hi, ngual atu seam tu in le mi tampi tatkhiat natu a nuntakna pia tu in hongpai hi,

content: ci hi.
Jesus in Mittaw Bartimaeus Khuamusak
Jesus le a nungzui te Jericho ah hongpai uh a: amate mihon tampi taw Jericho pan a pusua uh ciang in, Timaeus i tapa, Bartimaeus a kici mittaw pa sia lamhui ah to in khutdaw ngen hi.
Ama in Nazareth khua mi Jesus hi, ci a zak ciang in, David Tapa Jesus awng, hong hesuak kapo in, ci in au hi.
Mi tampi te in ama a om khikhep natu in tei uh hi kale: Nang David Tapa awng, hong hesuak kapo in, ci in au seseam hi.
Jesus ding a, ama sam tu in thupia hi. Amate in mittaw pa kungah, thinnuam in a, ding in; Ama in hong sam hi, ci uh hi.
A puantual sil sia khia in, ding a, Jesus kungah pai hi.
Jesus in ama zo a,

content.text: Nang tungah bang ka vawt tu uk ni ziam?

content: ci hi. Mittaw pa in, Topa awng, ka mit khua mu tu uk khi hi, ci hi.

content.text: Jesus in ama kungah, pai in; na upna in hong damsak zo hi,

content: ci hi. Tasia pociang in khuamu a, lampi ah Jesus nungzui hi.
